title: Rav Ahilai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Berakhot 25b, Rav Ahilai (according to the reading of Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin) arranged his son’s marriage into the household of Rav Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta and brought him into the wedding canopy, etc. There is also a Rava or Rabbah bar Ahilai: Pesachim 30a.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Berakhot 25b names Rav Achai; Hyman reports Ahilai from Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin. The William Davidson Pesachim 30a reads Rava bar Ahilai. These are named digital readings, not an inspection of Vilna print pixels.
The exact Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin readings remain Hyman’s reports. The Rava and Rabbah forms are retained at their respective occurrences.
